red.purpose: Bright accent red kept only for small marks on light fields (input caret).

red-panel.purpose: The single flat page ground — the whole room, edge to edge, no panels.

brand.purpose: The « Chez Mamie » wordmark under the medallion. Amatic SC 700, self-hosted OFL.

chip.purpose: Top-bar chips: painted words straight on the red, active underlined in gold, old name revealed on hover. Amatic SC 700.

display.purpose: Section headings and recipe names. Lilita One 400, self-hosted OFL.

body.purpose: All functional text on red. Karla variable 200-800, self-hosted OFL.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons on hover, with translateY(-1px).

shadows.name: framed-photo
shadows.purpose: Recipe images on the red ground.

motion.name: panel-in
motion.purpose: Single authored moment: tab panel entrance (opacity + 10px rise), disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on the red ground: gold pill, Encre Brune label, hover lifts to Or Vif.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--gold); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.92rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(46,6,8,0.3); transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gold-bright); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(46,6,8,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary and destructive actions: transparent pill with a 1.5px gold- or cream-tinted border that fills with a translucent tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { padding: 0.45rem 1rem; border: 1.5px solid rgba(246,217,160,0.55); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--gold-soft); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(232,160,32,0.2); color: var(--gold-bright); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The order slip: light field on red with a gold-tinted border, gold focus ring, red caret.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem; border: 1.5px solid rgba(232,160,32,0.55); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--field); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.95rem; caret-color: var(--red); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7A5F4A; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--gold); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(232,160,32,0.35); outline: none; }

components.name: Painted Chips
components.description: Section navigation as hand-lettered words straight on the red ground, centered above the brand sign; the active chip takes a gold underline, hover turns the word Or Pâle and reveals the former name beneath.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active">Mes plats</button><button class="ds-tab">Les recettes de mamie</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem 1.9rem; } .ds-tab { position: relative; flex: none; padding: 0 0 0.22rem; border: none; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: none; box-shadow: none; color: var(--cream); font-family: var(--font-brand); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.55rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--gold-soft); } .ds-tab-active { border-bottom-color: var(--gold); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section on the Ground
components.description: No panel: each tab's content lies directly on the flat banquette-red ground; the gold heading is closed by a double gold rule.
components.html:
Mes recettes

Contenu de la section.
components.css: .ds-section { background: transparent; color: var(--cream); } .ds-section-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.55rem; letter-spacing: 0.015em; color: var(--gold); border-bottom: 4px double var(--gold); padding-bottom: 0.35rem; }

components.name: Menu Line
components.description: Signature recipe entry: cream display name, dotted gold leader, portion count in Or Pâle on the right.
components.css: .ds-menu-line { position: relative; padding: 0.9rem 0 1rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--gold-line-soft); } .ds-menu-line::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2.05rem; left: 0; right: 0; border-top: 2px dotted rgba(246,217,160,0.4); } .ds-menu-line > strong { position: relative; display: inline-block; background: var(--red-panel); padding-right: 0.55rem; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.3rem; letter-spacing: 0.015em; color: var(--cream); } .ds-menu-line > .ds-servings { float: right; position: relative; background: var(--red-panel); padding-left: 0.55rem; margin-top: 0.25rem; color: var(--gold-soft); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.9rem; }

components.name: Ingredient Chip
components.description: Basil-green pill for ingredient tags and provenance; step-ingredient chips start as light slips and turn green when checked.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; background: var(--green); border: 1px solid var(--green-deep); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem; color: var(--cream); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: Chez Mamie is a vibrant restaurant dining room you cook from: one flat banquette red (#A82118) carries the whole room — ground, sections, and the auth door alike, no panels, no paper — with mustard-gold brass for service and basil green for everything fresh. The world reaches the screen through type, palette, density, and one signature move — the dotted-leader menu line — never through re-invented controls.
keyCharacteristics: One flat banquette-red ground (#A82118) edge to edge — no panels, no paper, no page gradient
Lilita One display lettering over a Karla text face
Dotted-leader menu lines as the recipe list's signature
Mustard gold for service (rules, focus, primary actions, active tab), basil green for freshness (ingredients, provenance, checked states)
Deeper red insets (#8A1A12) only where a control needs a recess (ingredient picker, step rows, image placeholders)

rules.name: The Red Is the Room Rule
rules.body: Everything is the red room: one flat banquette red carries the whole page, insets go deeper still. No panel, card, or cover sits between the content and the room. No cream, white, or gray surface ever ships — cream exists only as text, light fields only as small writing slips.

rules.name: The Gold Is a Waiter Rule
rules.body: Gold serves; it never speaks paragraphs. It appears as rules, rings, buttons, and the active tab — always with dark ink when it carries text, or as large display lettering on red.

rules.name: The Basil Rule
rules.body: Green marks freshness and provenance: ingredients, the catalogue badge, checked states. Always a filled mark with cream text, never a text color on red.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Display lettering speaks names and sections; Karla speaks everything actionable.

rules.name: The Soft Landing Rule
rules.body: Every shadow carries an offset and a blur in the red-dark hue; a zero-blur block shadow never ships.

dos: Do keep every surface in the red family — one flat banquette ground, deep insets; cream is only ever text.
Do write headings in Lilita One and close them with the 4px double gold rule.
Do reserve gold for rules, focus, primary actions, and the active tab — always with dark ink when it carries text.
Do reserve green for freshness marks (ingredients, provenance badge, checked states) — always as a filled mark with cream text.
Do tint secondary text from the cream (#F3D9B4), never neutral gray.
Do theme browser surfaces from the palette (selection, caret, scrollbars, focus rings, accent-color in Vert Basilic).
donts: Don't put cream, white, or gray panels on the red ground — the room is red or it isn't this design.
Don't use gold or green as body-text color on red (gold speaks only large, green never speaks; both are marks, not voices).
Don't ship hard offset block shadows or solid hairline separators — shadows are soft, separators are dashed or dotted.
Don't re-invent controls in the restaurant's image: tabs, inputs, and buttons stay standard and scannable; the world lives in type, palette, density, and the dotted leader.
